items.title: Pay patient's share for hearing aids
items.quote: Den Betrag erbitten wir innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum auf unser Konto;
items.computation: The invoice is dated Thu 19.11.2026 and this is a company (not an authority), so no deemed-delivery rule applies; the period runs from the invoice date itself. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (19.11.) is not counted, so counting starts 20.11.2026. 30 days later (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) falls on Sat 19.12.2026. Since that is a Saturday, § 193 BGB shifts the deadline to the next business day, Mon 21.12.2026. Allowing one business day for the bank transfer to arrive (§ 675s BGB), the payment should be sent by Fri 18.12.2026 at the latest.

warnings: The letter offers 'Ratenzahlung ist nach Absprache möglich' (installment payment by arrangement) — if the full amount cannot be paid by the due date, contact the provider directly using the phone number or email printed on the invoice (not any contact details from elsewhere) to arrange this before the deadline.

The printed IBAN (DE36 3705 0198 0005 5277 00) is well-formed and German, consistent with a Hesse-based provider, but a valid IBAN does not prove ownership — before paying, check the payee name shown by your bank's mandatory name-check against 'Hörakustik Beispielklang' and compare the account details with any earlier invoice from this provider if available.
